en.headline: Coffee festival shifts to Taikoo after Star Street run
en.dek: Swire Properties says Coffee Voyage moves to Taikoo from Thursday to Sunday after a four-day weekend in Wan Chai.
body: A cross-district coffee fair that spent the National Day weekend in Wan Chai is due to open its next leg in Taikoo on Thursday, Swire Properties said.

The organiser said Coffee Voyage 2026 ran in the Star Street precinct from 1 to 4 October and will continue at Cityplaza and Taikoo Place from 8 to 11 October, before a later stop at Citygate Outlets from 22 to 25 October. The fair brings together more than 40 coffee and dessert names from Japan and Hong Kong, including more than a dozen appearing in the city for the first time. Among them is Ogawa Coffee, a Kyoto shop the organiser described as having several baristas who have placed in Japanese and international competitions.

Swire Properties said proceeds from the event would go to Tung Wah Group of Hospitals' coffee-and-walking programme for older people and to the Agency for Volunteer Service. The Star Street dates have already ended. The company did not publish a full stall list or entry fee for the Taikoo dates in the announcement cited by local reports.

zh.headline: 星街咖啡節結束 周四起移師太古
zh.dek: 太古地產表示，「悠遊咖期」國慶周末在灣仔星街舉行後，周四至周日改到太古繼續。
body: 國慶假期在灣仔星街舉行的跨區咖啡節，下一站將於周四移到太古。太古地產早前公布活動安排。
主辦方稱，「悠遊咖期2026」已於10月1日至4日在星街小區舉行，10月8日至11日移師太古城中心及太古坊，其後再於10月22日至25日到東薈城名店倉。活動匯集逾40個來自日本及香港的咖啡及甜品品牌，當中超過12個首次在港亮相，包括京都老字號小川咖啡，主辦方指其店內有多名曾於日本及國際賽事獲獎的咖啡師。
太古地產表示，活動收益會撥捐東華三院「越齡『咖啡·走動』計劃」及義務工作發展局。星街場次已經結束。本地報道引述的公布，未有列出太古場的完整攤檔名單或入場收費。
